description: This file defines an abstract Scala class `AbstractDiagnosticLoggingAdapter` that implements the `DiagnosticLoggingAdapter` interface for logging purposes, with support for MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) management and correlation IDs, intended for use in Java implementations.

classes.name: AbstractDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class that implements DiagnosticLoggingAdapter, providing MDC management methods and intended to be extended for custom logging behavior.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Associates a diagnostic context value with a key for this logger, returning the logger for chaining.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes a diagnostic context value associated with the specified key.

methods.name: discardMdcEntries
methods.description: Removes all diagnostic context values from this logger.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this logger.
